task: classify remote agent branches before selecting the session baseline

baseline.method: one for-each-ref inventory plus one merge-base ancestry check per ref

intervention.method: one inventory plus native merged and no-merged filters

measurement_notes: The branch audit was required by the repository workflow and was not invented for the probe.
Only remote refs under refs/remotes/origin/agent/ were classified against the fetched origin/main.
The evaluation repeated the per-ref checks to compare sets; those 12 Git processes are not hidden from the interpretation.
Repository contents, credentials and connector payloads are not retained.
The narrow process count does not measure latency, context, decision quality or full session overhead, so the utility outcome is inconclusive.
